note.goal: Complete a clean production smoke test against the live site after the final release candidate.
note.whyItMatters: The final release must be proven live without mistaking a skipped deploy or propagation window for success or failure.
note.filesToTouch: TBD — verify against official source on the day
note.readExactly: AGENTS.md, TASKVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, this ticket, REMAINING-WORK.md, and the live site
note.constraints: Do not trust the deploy job conclusion alone, do not report propagation zeros as a failure, and do not explain them away. Re-run inconsistent checks, and do not push a second change while the first still needs live verification.
doneWhen: the smoke test is clean on a re-run
the test is against the live site
the test is on the final RC

title: [OPS] REL-06 stays WON'T FIX on zero-spend grounds

note.summary: This decision is already closed 2026-07-28 after the request-mode-dependent root cause was found. `assets.run_worker_first: ["/api/*"]` works, but it remains forbidden because Worker invocations count against the daily request limit while static-asset requests are free, and the app's own `/api/*` fetch calls are unaffected.
note.goal: Keep REL-06 closed unless the owner explicitly decides to relax the zero-spend guard.

note.constraints: Do not add `assets.run_worker_first: ["/api/*"]` or weaken the assertion matching `/run_worker_first/` without an explicit owner decision to relax the zero-spend guard.
doneWhen: REL-06 remains closed as WON'T FIX
the zero-spend guard remains intact
note.priorityRationale: Low priority because the behaviour is low severity and the zero-spend decision is already closed.
